test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A clock is sold for ₹550 cash or in the instalment scheme, for ₹250 cash down payment and ₹310 after one month. Find the rate of interest charged in the instalment scheme.
solution:
**Given:**

Cash price of the clock = ₹550

Down payment = ₹250

Amount paid after one month = ₹310

Time = 1 month = 1/12 year

**Formula used:**

Principal (P) = Cash price - Down payment

Interest (I) = Amount paid - Principal
